title: Increasing Transparent and Accountable Use of Data by Quantifying the Actual Privacy Risk in Interactive Record Linkage
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying privacy risk (KAPR score) in interactive record linkage to support transparency and decisions on privacy-utility trade-offs. While privacy and accountability are ethical considerations in data handling, the paper does not engage in evaluating or benchmarking broader moral philosophies, ethical frameworks, or religious/faith aspects. Its scope is a technical measure of privacy risk within a specific data task.
